title: Write 4 · 找 觉 得 重 正 身 晚 记 体 马 能 做 什 么 吧
focus: 找 觉 得 重 正 身 晚 记 体 马 能 做 什 么 吧
body:
Repeating parts: 亻 person (体, 做, 什), 讠 speech (记), 扌 hand (找), 日 (得, 晚), 己 self (记), 见 (觉), 匕 (能).

## Rules that matter here
- **Long through-strokes last**: 身's final ノ, 重's base.
- 己 jǐ (open) vs 已 yǐ (half closed) vs 巳 sì (closed): 记 and 起 use 己.
- 找 vs 我: 扌 + 戈 vs a different left side.

cards.Notes: 扌 hand (3) + 戈 (4) = 7 strokes. 扌: 一, vertical hook, rising stroke; 戈's dot last. Lookalike: 我 (7, different left side).
⺍ (3) + 冖 cover (2) + 见 see (4) = 9 strokes. Top to bottom. jiào in 睡觉, jué in 觉得. Lookalike: 学 (子 at bottom).
彳 step (3) + 日 (4) + 一 + 寸 (3) = 11 strokes. Left, then right top to bottom. Also dé (得到), děi.
9 strokes: ノ and the top 一 first, then a 里-like body with the vertical through it, long bottom 一 last. Also chóng (重新).
5 strokes: top 一, middle 丨, short 一 to the right, short left 丨, long bottom 一. Lookalike: 止 (no top line).
7 strokes: ノ, 丨, 横折钩, two inner 一, rising 提, and the long ノ through it LAST. A pictograph of a body.
日 sun (4) + 免 (7, phonetic miǎn) = 11 strokes. Left before right; 免 ends with 竖弯钩. Lookalike: 挽, 换 (different).
讠 speech (2) + 己 self (3, phonetic jǐ) = 5 strokes. Watch: 己 (open top-left) not 已.
亻 person (2) + 本 root (5) = 7 strokes. Left before right; in 本 the short bottom 一 is last. Lookalike: 休 (亻 + 木, no line).
3 strokes: 横折 (𠃍), then 竖折折钩, then the bottom horizontal last. Phonetic in 吗, 妈, 骂.
厶 (2) + 月 (4) on the left + two 匕 (2 + 2) on the right = 10 strokes. Left column first, then right top to bottom.
亻 person (2) + 古 old (5, phonetic gǔ) + 攵 strike (4) = 11 strokes. Left to right. Lookalike: 作 (same sound, 亻 + 乍).
亻 person (2) + 十 ten (2) = 4 strokes. Horizontal before vertical in 十. Lookalike: 计 (讠 + 十).
3 strokes: ノ, 𠃋 (撇折), then the dot. Lookalikes: 公 (八 on top), 去 (土 on top).
口 mouth (3, sentence particle) + 巴 (4, phonetic bā) = 7 strokes. 巴: 横折, 丨, 一, then 竖弯钩 last.
